messages.text:
I’m sorry for the delay. The shop’s records don’t yet show your king-size duvet set as received back, and no refund has been issued. Items must be received before a refund can proceed (refund-policy/v2/return).

Since you’ve already sent it, a person will take over to check the missing return (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).
